title: Belgium's most caps since 2000
brief: Name the ten players with the most caps for Belgium in full internationals since 1 January 2000, to the 2026 World Cup final. Only games from 2000 on count.
period: Full internationals from 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026

notes.Vincent Kompany: Vincent Kompany is 11th with 89 caps, one short.
notes.Daniel Van Buyten: Daniel Van Buyten is joint 13th with 85 caps.
notes.Thomas Vermaelen: Thomas Vermaelen is joint 13th with 85 caps.

sources: https://tmapi.transfermarkt.technology/player/<id>/performance-game (Transfermarkt match-by-match national team record for each player)
https://www.national-football-teams.com/country/20/2026/Belgium.html (and each player page, /player/<id>/<name>.html, listing every match)
checks: Transfermarkt's match-by-match record for each player and national-football-teams.com's match list for each player were both counted between the board's dates and agree on every figure in the ten and on 11th and 12th. Lukaku, De Bruyne and Tielemans have played again since 19 July 2026; those games are not counted (Tielemans 90 to the cut-off, 93 now).
